uvod.tekst: We invite you to try our excellent pizzas, prepared with love and the skilled hands of experienced pizza maker Marko. In addition to crispy pizzas, we also offer other delicacies prepared especially for you. Vegan cheese is also available for vegans. We also provide lunches for closed groups of 15 people or more by prior reservation at +386 31 307 279.

ambient.naslov: A pleasant atmosphere for all generations
ambient.tekst: Our interior is designed 'from the barn floor' – a traditional wooden rural building. The heart of the space is a bread oven that provides warmth and a relaxed atmosphere.

okolica.tekst: Our guesthouse is located on a picturesque hill with a beautiful view of the Krka River valley. Just a few steps away rises Mount Bovljek, a popular destination for short hikes and relaxation in nature. After a refreshing walk or trip, you can enjoy delicious Neapolitan pizzas, refreshing drinks, and a pleasant atmosphere.
okolica.list1: Unforgettable view of the Krka River valley
okolica.list2: Excellent starting point for short hikes
okolica.list3: Pleasant environment for relaxation and socializing

veganski.naslov: Also for lovers of vegan pizza
veganski.tekst: You can also enjoy delicious vegan pizzas with us. Selected pizzas can be prepared with vegan cheese and carefully chosen ingredients, so you don't have to compromise on great taste. Take a look at our menu and find your favorite combination.

gostilna.opis_1: Some time ago, our dream came true. In the Suha Krajina region, in the village of Kuželjevec, we opened Guesthouse Pod Podom. We invite you to try our delicious pizzas prepared with love and other delicacies we create for you.
gostilna.opis_2: Every visit and every compliment means a lot to us – it drives us forward and gives us even more motivation to work. Thank you for believing in our effort!

lokacija.opis_1: On the terrace, you will be spoiled with a beautiful view of the surrounding hills, green forests in spring, autumn colors, and winter idyll – in all seasons. You will feel peace, relax, and hear birds. You can also take a walk to nearby Mount Bovljek. Experience it with us – welcome!
lokacija.opis_2: About a 20-minute walk from the guesthouse rises Mount Bovljek, a popular destination for short hikes. The path to the top is easy and suitable for all generations. In the near future, a lookout tower will be built on the summit, offering views of the entire Suha Krajina and beyond.
